sources.zh.name: 斯坦福大学
sources.zh.description: 位于美国加州史丹佛的私立大学，于1891年创校
sources.zh.encyclopediaLead:
小利蘭·史丹佛大學（Leland Stanford Junior University），通称史丹佛大學（Stanford University），简称斯坦福（Stanford），是一所美國私立研究型大學，坐落於加利福尼亚州临近硅谷的史丹佛，是美国大学协会的创始会员，因其學術聲譽和创业氛围而獲評為世上最知名的高等學府之一.

史丹佛大學於1891年由時任加州參議員及州長的鐵路大亨利蘭·史丹佛和他的妻子創辦，用以紀念他們因傷寒而於16歲生日前夕去世的兒子. 斯坦福大学建立之初即為男女兼收及宗教自由的學校，且於1930年代前所有學費全免. 然而，因1893年利蘭·史丹佛的逝世及1906年三藩市大地震對校園造成重大損毀，該校面臨嚴峻的財政負擔，因而取消免收學費的政策. 二次世界大戰後，時任學校教務長的弗雷德里克·特曼全力支持校友與教職員的创业精神，希望能建立一個自給自足的本地工業，這也是現今硅谷的源流.

史丹佛大學由七所學院組成，校園佔地 8,180 英畝（3,310 公頃），是全國最大的校園之一. 該大學被歸類為級別最高的第一級研究型大學. 史丹佛大學設有公共政策智庫胡佛研究所. 學校的校園位於矽谷的西北方，鄰近帕羅奧圖.
sources.en.name: Stanford University
sources.en.description: private research university in Stanford, California, USA
sources.en.encyclopediaLead:
Leland Stanford Junior University, commonly referred to as Stanford University, is a private research university in Stanford, California, United States. It was founded in 1885 by railroad magnate Leland Stanford (the eighth governor of and then-incumbent United States senator representing California) and his wife, Jane, in memory of their only child, Leland Jr.

The university admitted its first students in 1891, opening as a coeducational and non-denominational institution. It struggled financially after Leland died in 1893 and again after much of the campus was damaged by the 1906 San Francisco earthquake. Following World War II, university provost Frederick Terman inspired an entrepreneurial culture to build a self-sufficient local industry (later Silicon Valley). In 1951, Stanford Research Park was established in Palo Alto as the world's first university research park. By 2021, the university had 2,288 tenure-line faculty, senior fellows, center fellows, and medical faculty on staff.

The university is organized around seven schools of study on an 8,180 acre campus, one of the largest in the nation. It houses the Hoover Institution, a public policy think tank, and is classified among "R1: Doctoral Universities – Very high research activity". Students compete in 36 varsity sports, and the university is one of eight private institutions in the Atlantic Coast Conference (ACC). Stanford has won 136 NCAA team championships, and was awarded the NACDA Directors' Cup for 25 consecutive years, beginning in 1994. Students and alumni have won 302 Olympic medals (including 153 gold).
